claims: The letters CR indicate that the battery is a lithium manganese dioxide coin cell.
The first two digits, 20, represent the diameter of the battery in millimeters.
The last two digits, 32, represent the thickness of the battery in tenths of a millimeter.

claims.text: In the CR2032 battery name, the numbers indicate a 20 mm diameter and a 3.2 mm height.
